cards.title: Tree-like residential network
cards.claim: Junctions inside Mount Lavinia GN are 3-way dominated (0.11 : 0.89); the residential fabric is tree-like rather than a permeable grid.

cards.title: Cul-de-sacs and short local links
cards.claim: 65 cul-de-sacs and median junction spacing 64.3 m show subdivided residential enclosure with limited local permeability.

cards.title: Spines carry permeability; interior stays tree-like
cards.claim: Corridor 4-way share (17%) exceeds interior (9%); destination access and centrality ride spines, not a grid fabric.

design_priorities: Prefer interior permeability upgrades over assuming walk access proves grid form
